The plan for today on the website — option B, in the app's typography

Type matched to the app's components (TimeBlockSection, TodayPlanPanel): Cinzel 15px tracked caps for the parts of the day, 14px counts, EB Garamond 21px names with 16px subtitles, the subtle 24px check circle, 6px tier dots. Sample plan modelled on your screenshot.

Wide screens: the plan stands at the top of the right column (dark, Portuguese)

The app's own wide-window panel (TodayPlanPanel): a PLANO DE VIDA marker, then the parts of the day. Finished parts fold to one line with a check; the current part is open; later parts preview what is left. Clicking a part opens or folds it; the circle ticks a practice; the name opens its prayer page.
